description: This is a Swift source file that serves as the main entry point for a command-line application. It uses the Commander library to parse and dispatch CLI commands related to 'swabble' functionalities like 'serve', 'transcribe', 'mic', 'service', etc. It defines functions to handle different command dispatching based on parsed arguments, and includes error handling for unknown commands or subcommands.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Main function to run the CLI, initializes command descriptors and resolves invocation arguments, dispatching to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the command invocation based on the parsed command path, routing 'swabble' commands accordingly.

methods.name: dispatchSwabble
methods.description: Handles subcommands specific to 'swabble', routing to handlers like 'mic', 'service', or custom commands.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping 'swabble' subcommand names to their async handler functions.

methods.name: dispatchMic
methods.description: Handles subcommands under 'mic', such as 'list' and 'set'.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Extracts a specific subcommand from the command path at a given index, with error handling.
